WITH DeleteDups AS 
(
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TRADE_ID ORDER BY TRADE_ID, CAST(MODIF_DATE AS DATE),Product_Family,Product_Type, Product_Sub_Type )  RN
FROM tbl_Calypso_Lifecycle_Stage
WHERE      (System_Source = 'SCP') AND (Lifecycle_Event = 'New Deal')
) 
DELETE FROM DeleteDups
WHERE DeleteDups.RN > 1
